source.snippet: Ask HN: What do your technical interviews look like today? (Nov 2026) — 'We may be past the point of leetcode challenges, but now different companies have different levels of acceptance for AI assistance. One data point talked about technical interviews where a candidate was interrupted and asked to lean on the LLM more. Some companies have shied away from AI and any indication or disclosure of AI...' Points: 6, Comments: 3.

problem_statement: Engineering hiring managers lack standardized, defensible technical interview formats for the AI-augmented era — existing formats either ignore AI or inconsistently accept it, creating candidate confusion and unreliable signal.
target_segment: Engineering hiring managers and technical recruiters at software companies of 20–500 employees conducting regular SWE hiring.
notes: Active discussion with 6 points and 3 comments on a Nov 2026 thread shows current, live pain. Companies pay for interview platforms (HackerRank, CoderPad, Karat) — a service that provides AI-era interview kits, rubrics, and tooling would have clear paying buyers in recruiting budgets. Signal is moderate — single thread but highly current.
